Since 2020, I have worked as a teaching assistant and tutor at the University of Stuttgart. I have led tutorials, exercise classes, and lecture-style exercise sessions, prepared and graded assignments, held student consultations, and contributed to exam preparation.

## Courses

- Measure and Probability Theory
- Mathematical Statistics
- Stochastic Processes
- Stochastics and Numerical Mathematics for Teacher Education
- Analysis I–II
- Higher Mathematics for Physicists I–II
- Mathematics for Economists I–II
